title: Pairing Expert Critique with LLM-Driven Refinement: An Iterative Approach for Curating Quality AI Evaluation Datasets
abstract: arXiv:2611.05749v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Evaluating and improving domain-specific LLM responses requires high-quality reference data and rubrics, yet expert authoring is slow and expensive, and synthetic datasets may fail to capture practitioner preferences unless they are grounded in expert judgment. We present SME-C (Subject Matter Expert Critique), a human-AI workflow that captures expertise through lightweight critiques of candidate responses and complements it with LLM-driven analysis and refinement to iteratively curate response datasets and evaluation rubrics. We validate SME-C in the domain of financial business briefs, collecting 3,853 critiques from 411 finance professionals on 520 queries across two survey rounds. We evaluate two LLM-driven refinement strategies: one guided by the experts' written critiques and one that infers critique solely from their preference votes. translated_title: 将专家点评与LLM驱动的精炼相结合：一种迭代式方法用于筛选高质量AI评估数据集
translated_abstract: 评估和改进特定领域的LLM回答需要高质量的参考数据和评分标准，然而由专家撰写既缓慢又昂贵，而合成数据集除非以专家判断为基础，否则可能无法捕捉从业者的真实偏好。我们提出了SME-C（领域专家点评，Subject Matter Expert Critique），这是一种人机协作工作流程，通过对候选回答的轻量级点评来捕捉专家知识，并结合LLM驱动的分析与精炼，迭代式地筛选回答数据集和评估评分标准。我们在金融商业简报领域验证了SME-C，在两轮调查中收集了411位金融专业人士针对520个查询给出的3,853条点评。我们评估了两种LLM驱动的精炼策略：一种以专家的书面点评为指导，另一种仅从专家的偏好投票中推断点评内容。在对另外100位专业人士进行的盲测验证调查中，我们发现两种策略……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出SME-C人机协作工作流程，通过专家轻量级点评结合LLM驱动的分析与精炼，迭代式筛选高质量AI评估数据集与评分标准，并在金融商业简报领域收集411位专业人士的3,853条点评验证了两种LLM精炼策略的有效性。
en_tdlr: SME-C is a human-AI workflow that pairs lightweight expert critiques with LLM-driven analysis and refinement to iteratively curate high-quality AI evaluation datasets and rubrics, validated in the financial business briefs domain through 3,853 critiques from 411 finance professionals.
